description: This PHP source file defines the SchedulerMigrationService class, which handles migrating legacy Google Calendar sync schedulers to a new calendar synchronization system within the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for validation, finding legacy schedulers, checking for existing new schedulers, performing the migration (with dry-run support), and retrieving migration status.

classes.name: SchedulerMigrationService
classes.description: Handles migration of scheduler jobs from legacy GoogleSync system to the new CalendarSync system, including validation, finding legacy schedulers, checking for existing schedulers, performing migrations with optional dry run, and reporting migration status.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes database and logger managers required for migration operations.

methods.name: validateSchedulerMigrationRequirements
methods.description: Checks if necessary database tables and classes exist to proceed with migration.

methods.name: findLegacyGoogleSyncSchedulers
methods.description: Retrieves scheduler records corresponding to legacy 'syncGoogleCalendar' jobs that are active and not deleted.

methods.name: hasNewCalendarSyncScheduler
methods.description: Checks if a new calendar sync scheduler already exists in the system.

methods.name: migrateScheduler
methods.description: Performs migration of legacy schedulers to the new system, optionally in dry run mode; updates scheduler records and logs operations.

methods.name: getSchedulerMigrationStatus
methods.description: Provides a summary of migration status, including counts of legacy schedulers and whether the new scheduler exists.
